crossRefs.note: “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,
so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.
I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.
“Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me…
I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my…
But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree. Then he requested…
Therefore now, Yahweh, take, I beg you, my life from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.”
When the sun arose, God prepared a sultry east wind; and the sun beat on Jonah’s head, so that he fainted, and…
In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from…
“Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends; for the hand of God has touched me.
For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer.
Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver. I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction.

translations.web: even that it would please God to crush me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
translations.bsb: that God would be willing to crush me, to unleash His hand and cut me off!
translations.kjv: Even that it would please God to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
translations.asv: Even that it would please God to crush me; That he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
